items.title: Australia's mammals are at risk of bird flu. This is what we know
items.description: While birds are the most likely victims of the deadly strain of bird flu, researchers are also sounding the alarm for native mammals and marsupial species. These are some of the steps being taken to protect them.

items.title: Award-winning artist accused of copying second artwork
items.description: Australian artist Jane Allan, revealed to have previously copied another painter's work, is being accused of a second case of imitation.

items.title: Robbed, bashed, killed: How killers targeted one couple over several years
items.description: Twenty-four years after the killing of a Canberra grandmother, a coffee cup discarded on an east coast road trip leads to the arrest and convictions of her killers.

items.title: Has One Nation won the 'family feud' of Australian conservatives?
items.description: There's a "family feud" in Australia's political right, and right now it appears One Nation is winning.

items.title: Will Congress demanding US military halt action in Iran end the war?
items.description: The US Senate approved a war powers resolution seeking to block military action against Iran on Tuesday. But don't expect the war to end.

items.title: Deadly bird flu discovered in second Australian state as virus found in SA
items.description: A third confirmed case of the deadly H5 bird flu has been found in a migratory bird on Australia's southern coast.

items.title: Christian Brothers spending $1.7m a week on abuse cases
items.description: The Congregation of Christian Brothers Oceania Province has revealed it was seeking to sell off its 36 properties to pay abuse victims, who would be treated as creditors.

items.title: Socceroos should make 'harsh' call for final group game, Schwarzer says
items.description: As the Socceroos prepare to face Paraguay in their final FIFA World Cup group game, Aussie great Mark Schwarzer says now is the time to bring captain Mat Ryan back into the team.

items.title: Police to review case of Epstein accuser Virginia Giuffre
items.description: The interactions Jeffery Epstein accuser Virginia Giuffre had with Australian police before her death will be reviewed, WA's police commissioner confirms.

items.title: Karl Stefanovic's interview with Tommy Robinson taken offline
items.description: Today show host-turned-podcaster Karl Stefanovic has had his interview with far-right extremist Tommy Robinson taken down from social media and podcast platforms.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
